dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Hi. How do I send this package to Canada?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaɪ. ˈhaʊ duː aɪ ˈsɛnd ðɪs ˈpækɪdʒ tə ˈkænədə?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: First, write the address on this form, please.
dialogue.reading: ˈfɜːrst, ˈraɪt ði ˈædrɛs ɑːn ðɪs ˈfɔːrm, ˈpliːz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. And how do I send this envelope?
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. ənd ˈhaʊ duː aɪ ˈsɛnd ðɪs ˈɛnvəloʊp?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: You need a stamp. It's fifty baht to Canada.
dialogue.reading: juː ˈniːd ə ˈstæmp. ɪts ˈfɪfti ˈbɑːt tə ˈkænədə.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: It goes in the corner, on the right.
dialogue.reading: ɪt ˈɡoʊz ɪn ðə ˈkɔːrnər, ɑːn ðə ˈraɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thanks. How do I pay? Can I pay by card?
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks. ˈhaʊ duː aɪ ˈpeɪ? kən aɪ ˈpeɪ baɪ ˈkɑːrd?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes, card or cash is fine.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ˈkɑːrd ɔːr ˈkæʃ ɪz ˈfaɪn.
